messages:
Dana Lewis: Heads-up: VeloxCloud invoice VXC-2026-11-990 for $5,760 arrived with no PO and billed to CLOUD-OPS instead of ENG-Platform. PDF in vendor portal.

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: VeloxCloud VXC-2026-11-990, amount $5,760. No PO detected. AP ticket AP-9045 created. Recommended action: HOLD.

Marco Ruiz: We scoped a short proof-of-concept for the encoder service and told them it would be covered by trial credits. Looks like trial exhausted and vendor billed full usage. Cost center should be ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602).

Dana Lewis: I'll request corrected invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-091 or a credit memo so they can rebill. Draft message: "Per policy, invoices must reference a valid PO. Please reissue with PO-ENG-2026-091 or issue credit."

Anika Rao: If vendor won't reissue, we will not pay without VP sign-off. Procurement can create a retro PO `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-020` only with my approval. Hold payment and attach usage logs.

Marco Ruiz: Uploading usage: s3://redwood-logs/poc/encoder/2026-11/11-12-13.csv — shows 0.9TB used vs vendor billed 1.5TB. Adding to AP-9045.

invoices-bot: AP-9045 update: vendor_contacted. Vendor offered partial credit $2,000 and to rebill remainder. SLA: vendor requests payment within 3 business days to avoid late fee.

Dana Lewis: Partial credit not acceptable unless we validate meters. Procurement, can you negotiate full correction?

Anika Rao: Procurement to negotiate. If vendor persists, route AP-9045 to legal after 7 business days. I'll review any retro PO request.

Marco Ruiz: Thanks. I'll attach meter snapshots and CC Procurement. Will wait 48 hours for vendor reply before escalation.

Dana Lewis: Marking invoice as disputed in accounting and keeping AP ticket open. Will update this thread when we have vendor docs or VP decision. :thumbsup:
